ownership.domain: immutable bounded optional bitrate 1000..60000 and FPS 10..90; no native resources
ownership.persistence: one pair of explicit intent fields, serialized Prefs access; UI coordinator owns writes
ownership.control: one retained immutable intent and last submitted edit under original controller lock; original connection/settings notices fence callbacks; clear revokes settings notice without consuming admission
ownership.ui: one Compose draft follows untouched host fields; original observation identity checked on UI delivery
ownership.cleanup: session disconnect resets current observation; existing socket/job owner unchanged; clear drops retained override intent and prevents later replay, without cancelling writes already accepted by original socket

limitations: Robolectric API 27/34; no tablet deployment or physical camera/display run
no migration of obsolete preference keys
